verzen.tekst: He who fears the Lord will do this.
verzen.html: He who fears the Lord will do this.

verzen.tekst: She will meet him like a mother,
verzen.html: She will meet him like a mother,

verzen.tekst: She will feed him with bread of understanding
verzen.html: She will feed him with bread of understanding

verzen.tekst: He will be stayed upon her, and will not be moved.
verzen.html: He will be stayed upon her, and will not be moved.

verzen.tekst: She will exalt him above his neighbours.
verzen.html: She will exalt him above his neighbours.

verzen.tekst: He will inherit joy, a crown of gladness,
verzen.html: He will inherit joy, a crown of gladness,

verzen.tekst: Foolish men will not obtain her.
verzen.html: Foolish men will not obtain her.

verzen.tekst: She is far from pride.
verzen.html: She is far from pride.

verzen.tekst: Praise is not attractive in the mouth of a sinner;
verzen.html: Praise is not attractive in the mouth of a sinner;

verzen.tekst: For praise will be spoken in wisdom;
verzen.html: For praise will be spoken in wisdom;

verzen.tekst: Don’t say, “It is through the Lord that I fell away;”
verzen.html: Don’t say, “It is through the Lord that I fell away;”

verzen.tekst: Don’t say, “It is he that caused me to err;”
verzen.html: Don’t say, “It is he that caused me to err;”

verzen.tekst: The Lord hates every abomination;
verzen.html: The Lord hates every abomination;

verzen.tekst: He himself made man from the beginning
verzen.html: He himself made man from the beginning

verzen.tekst: If you choose, you can keep the commandments.
verzen.html: If you choose, you can keep the commandments.

verzen.tekst: He has set fire and water before you.
verzen.html: He has set fire and water before you.

verzen.tekst: Before man is life and death.
verzen.html: Before man is life and death.

verzen.tekst: For the wisdom of the Lord is great.
verzen.html: For the wisdom of the Lord is great.

verzen.tekst: His eyes are upon those who fear him.
verzen.html: His eyes are upon those who fear him.

verzen.tekst: He has not commanded any man to be ungodly.
verzen.html: He has not commanded any man to be ungodly.
